payload.rationale: Multiple hard-gate id_integrity failures require changes in locked sections and/or ID renaming, which are disallowed. Specifically: (1) deliverable IDs must be reformatted (M#-D# to DL#) requiring edits across milestones and ID changes; (2) architecture/options risk references expect a different risk representation (likely K# IDs) requiring edits to /architecture/options and/or /risk_register, which are locked; (3) evidence pointer schema in decision_log requires structural changes in a locked canonical section; (4) R4/AT4 stage-sequence alignment requires edits to /requirements and /acceptance_tests, which are locked. These cannot be safely patched under current constraints. Reroute to schema/validator owner for authoritative format and locked-section updates.
